value.style_description: Psychobilly punk groove inspired by Tiger Army: driving upstroke-feel hihat eighths, heavy backbeat snare on 2 and 4, syncopated kick with a dark rockabilly swagger, ghost notes and a fill at the end

Psychobilly/punk groove inspired by Mad Sin: driving double-time hihat feel, hard-hitting backbeat snare on 2 and 4, aggressive kick pattern with syncopation, raw energy with ghost notes and a fill in the final bar

Fast California punk rock in the style of NOFX: relentless straight eighth-note hihat, snare on 2 and 4 with occasional ghost notes, driving kick pattern with syncopation, crash accent on bar 1, small fill at the end

Heavy rock groove inspired by Volbeat's style: driving kick pattern with syncopation, strong backbeat snare on 2 and 4, steady eighth-note ride with occasional open hihat accents, rockabilly-influenced fills at bar ends
Classic funk groove: tight 16th-note hihat with ghost notes on the snare, syncopated kick pattern, open hihat accents on the upbeats

Dreamy, atmospheric art-rock groove inspired by Radiohead: sparse, deliberate kick placement, snare with ghost notes and subtle rolls, shimmering ride for texture, occasional open hihat swells, restrained dynamics with an introspective feel
Raw street punk beat: relentless straight eighth-note hihat, heavy backbeat snare on 2 and 4, aggressive kick on 1 and offbeats, crash accent on bar 1, snare fill at the end of bar 2
Pop-punk groove in the style of driving 90s punk rock beats: straight eighth-note hihat (8th notes only), backbeat snare, occasional kick syncopation
Hard rock groove inspired by Back in Black: straight eighth-note hihat, powerful backbeat snare on 2 and 4, driving kick on beats 1 and 3 with occasional syncopation, simple and thunderous feel

Swampy driving classic rock groove in the style of late-60s CCR: straight eighth-note hihat with accented downbeats, heavy backbeat snare on 2 and 4, syncopated kick with an off-beat push on the 'and' of beats for that raw swamp-rock punch

Street-punk rock'n'roll groove inspired by Social Distortion: steady eighth-note closed hihat with slight velocity variation, punchy snare backbeat on 2 and 4, kick anchoring beat 1 with occasional double-hit push for swagger, crash accent on the downbeat, ghost snare leading into bar 4 fill

Pop-punk groove inspired by 90s Offspring-style punk rock: straight eighth-note hihat driving the energy, heavy snare backbeat on 2 and 4, syncopated kick hits for momentum, crash accents at the top, and a short fill at the end of the 4-bar loop
Pop-punk groove in the style of driving 90s punk rock beats: quarter-note hihat, backbeat snare, occasional kick syncopation
Pop-punk groove in the style of driving 90s punk rock beats: eighth-note hihat, backbeat snare, occasional kick syncopation

NYHC hardcore punk groove inspired by aggressive straight-edge NYC hardcore: driving straight eighth-notes on closed hihat, punchy heavy snare on 2 and 4 with ghost note accents, tight double-kick syncopation on the upbeats, crash accent on bar 1 downbeat, building tension toward a breakdown-ready fill in bar 4

Raw DC hardcore punk groove inspired by early 80s straight-edge: relentless straight eighth-note closed hihat driving the tempo, hard-hitting snare on beats 2 and 4, sparse aggressive kick on beat 1 and occasional syncopated hits, zero frills — pure stripped-down hardcore energy

Aggressive melodic metalcore groove inspired by fast-paced 2010s metalcore: relentless 16th-note double-kick bursts, tight closed hihat driving the verse, crushing snare backbeat on 2 and 4, ride accent on the bow for texture, crash punctuation on bar entries, ghost notes under the snare for density, and a breakdown-ready dynamic drop in bar 4 with tom accents
